newsitem.title: USA: Elsag sees meeting Q3, Q4 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Elsag sees meeting Q3, Q4 estimates.

text.p: Elsag Bailey Process Automation NV said on Monday that it expects to meet Wall Street analysts' consensus estimates for the second half of 1997.
Elsag, based in Amsterdam, reported second quarter operating earnings of $0.37 per share, down from $0.40 for the same period a year ago. The First Call consensus estimate was $0.37.

"For the second half of the year, although market conditions and currency continue to have significant impact, we believe that an earnings target within the range of analysts' expectations is still achievable," Elsag Chief Executive Vincenzo Cannatelli said in a news release.
Elsag is a process automation company.
